description: Baseline after scheduler fairness, draft-depth cohort batching, grouped verification graph, and MMQ bounds fixes, before GPU draft sampling. These measurements must not be attributed to the subsequent GPU draft-sampling runtime.

concurrency_method.prompts: The same eight ordinary prompts repeated in balanced cycles.
concurrency_method.timing: Unprofiled client wall time. These short diagnostic concurrency baselines are separate from the five-repetition serving benchmark.

profiling_evidence: The compact transfer evidence is diagnostic Nsight data, separate from unprofiled throughput. Full vocabulary transfer sizes support investigation but do not uniquely attribute each transfer to a source call; summed transfer durations exclude host work and synchronization. Large SQLite/Nsight captures are not copied. The preserved script expects profile_c1.sqlite, profile_c6.sqlite, and profile_c8.sqlite beside it; original capture paths are recorded in the evidence JSON.
copy_validation: Each copied file SHA-256 matches the source, which was read again after copying to detect concurrent changes.
